colorReference.title: Color reference
colorReference.intro: Try colors on a live UI preview. Select an element, assign a palette token, and edit its color. Elements that share a token update together. Light and dark palettes have independent drafts.
colorReference.copyFailed: Use Export JSON to save the configuration.
colorReference.importFailed: Could not import this file. Choose a version 1 G4X color-reference JSON configuration.
colorReference.assignmentHelp: Choose an existing token to share a color with other elements. Editing a token changes every element assigned to it.
colorReference.shared: This token is also used by: {{elements}}.
colorReference.paletteHelp: Click a token to assign it to {{element}}.
colorReference.previewHelp: Turn on Pick element and click a surface or label to edit its assignment. Turn it off to try the controls.
colorReference.footer: These are local design drafts. Export includes both palettes and all element assignments; importing replaces both drafts. Reset restores the current palette and its assignments from the repository theme. Viewer styling and scientific data colors are unchanged. New element-to-token assignments can be implemented after review.
